correctness.rationale: For 0<h(1+δ)<2 the two squared multipliers are below one. A symmetric Markov joint-second-moment recursion gives a strictly positive determinant D, exactly solvable two-by-two linear system and explicit V(p). Exact algebra factors V(p)-σ²h/(2-h) by 2-t+2p(t-1), and the exact derivative has the sign of h-1. Boundary cases p=0, t=2, h=1, and p=1/2 are handled. verify.py confirmed five exact symbolic identities, five exact rational identities, and 240 independent numerical recurrences. Finite diagnostics do not serve as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The question compares a natural pair of equal-cost rate schedules with exactly the same one-step stepsize marginals and noise law. The result provides a complete sharp domain in which temporal anticorrelation turns a variance penalty into a variance reduction, an exact persistence cut-off p_c, and an independent h=1 monotonicity transition. A numerical method designer can distinguish alternating, IID and persistent schedules in a high-step stable regime. This is not an arbitrary numerical slice or a restatement of the generic covariance recursion; the parameter inequalities and ordering are the substantive result.
